headword: {入国|にゅうこく}{管理|かんり}

definitions.explanation: The government function of regulating the entry of foreign nationals into a country — checking passports and visas, issuing residence permits, and enforcing immigration law. Also used to refer to the system or agency responsible for these tasks. Frequently shortened to {入管|にゅうかん}.

examples.japanese: {入国|にゅうこく}{管理|かんり}は{厳|きび}しい。
{空港|くうこう}で{入国|にゅうこく}{管理|かんり}の{審査|しんさ}を{受|う}けた。
examples.english: I went through immigration inspection at the airport.

examples.japanese: {法務省|ほうむしょう}は{入国|にゅうこく}{管理|かんり}{制度|せいど}の{見直|みなお}しを{進|すす}めている。
examples.english: The Ministry of Justice is moving forward with a review of the immigration control system.

notes:
Compound of {入国|にゅうこく} ('entering a country') and {管理|かんり} ('management; control; administration'). Refers both to the regulatory function itself and, by extension, to the offices and officials who carry it out.

USAGE:
- A standard term in news reports, legal documents, and travel contexts.
- Often abbreviated to {入管|にゅうかん} in casual reference, news headlines, and institution names: {入管|にゅうかん}{法|ほう} ('Immigration Control Act'), {入管|にゅうかん}{施設|しせつ} ('immigration facility').
- In Japan, the relevant agency is the {出入国|しゅつにゅうこく}{在留|ざいりゅう}{管理庁|かんりちょう} (Immigration Services Agency), usually shortened to {入管庁|にゅうかんちょう}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {入国|にゅうこく}{管理|かんり}{局|きょく}: Immigration Bureau (the former name of the agency)
- {入国|にゅうこく}{管理|かんり}{法|ほう}: Immigration Control Act
- {入国|にゅうこく}{管理|かんり}の{審査|しんさ}: immigration inspection
- {厳|きび}しい{入国|にゅうこく}{管理|かんり}: strict immigration control
- {入国|にゅうこく}{管理|かんり}{官|かん}: immigration officer

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {入管|にゅうかん}: the common abbreviation — widely used in news headlines and speech.
- {出入国|しゅつにゅうこく}{管理|かんり}: immigration and emigration control — the broader official term covering both entry and exit.
- {税関|ぜいかん}: customs — a separate function dealing with goods rather than people.
- ビザ: visa — the document whose issuance and checking is central to immigration control.
